entities.summary: Bridget O'Connor was an English playwright and screenwriter. She won the BAFTA Award for Best Adapted Screenplay and was nominated for the Academy Award in the same category for her work on Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy, alongside her husband Peter Straughan.
